question.text: A <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">U</mi><mn>238</mn></msup></math> nucleus originally at rest, decays by emitting an alpha particle having a speed <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>u</mi></math>. Due to this emission, the residual nucleus recoils with a speed <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mi>n</mi><mi>u</mi></mrow><mn>234</mn></mfrac></math>. What is the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi></math>?

solution.text:
Apply conservation of linear momentum

     4u⁡-234v⁡=0

⇒    v⁡ = 4 u⁡ 2 3 4
n=4
